original_query: select    min(w_state)   ,min(i_item_id)   ,min(cs_item_sk)   ,min(cs_order_number)   ,min(cr_item_sk)   ,min(cr_order_number)  from    catalog_sales left outer join catalog_returns on        (cs_order_number = cr_order_number         and cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk)   ,warehouse   ,item   ,date_dim  where  i_item_sk          = cs_item_sk  and cs_warehouse_sk    = w_warehouse_sk  and cs_sold_date_sk    = d_date_sk  and d_date between (cast ('2001-04-07' as date) - interval '30' day)                 and (cast ('2001-04-07' as date) + interval '30' day)   and i_category  = 'Sports'  and i_manager_id between 61 and 100  and cs_wholesale_cost between 14 and 33  and cr_reason_sk = 40 ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT MIN(w_state) AS min_w_state,
       MIN(i_item_id) AS min_i_item_id,
       MIN(cs_item_sk) AS min_cs_item_sk,
       MIN(cs_order_number) AS min_cs_order_number,
       MIN(cr_item_sk) AS min_cr_item_sk,
       MIN(cr_order_number) AS min_cr_order_number
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN catalog_returns cr
  ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
 AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
JOIN item i
  ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d
  ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
JOIN warehouse w
  ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-03-08' AND DATE '2001-05-07'
  AND i.i_category = 'Sports'
  AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 61 AND 100
  AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 14 AND 33
  AND cr.cr_reason_sk = 40;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Convert LEFT OUTER JOIN to INNER JOIN: the WHERE clause `cr_reason_sk = 40` null-rejects all unmatched left-join rows, so the outer join is semantically equivalent to an inner join. Making it explicit improves readability and gives the optimizer full join-reordering freedom.
Replace implicit comma-style joins (warehouse, item, date_dim) with explicit ANSI JOIN syntax to eliminate accidental Cartesian-product risk and clarify join predicates.

Pre-compute the date arithmetic: `cast('2001-04-07' as date) - interval '30' day` = DATE '2001-03-08' and `+ interval '30' day` = DATE '2001-05-07'. Using plain DATE literals avoids runtime cast/interval computation and makes the range clearly sargable.

The predicates `i_category = 'Sports'`, `i_manager_id BETWEEN 61 AND 100`, `cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 14 AND 33`, and `cr_reason_sk = 40` are already selective and simple; they are retained as-is and placed with their respective table filters via explicit join structure.
No subqueries or redundant computations exist, so creating CTEs is not recommended — it could block predicate pushdown (pre-PG12 materialization) without any benefit.
